messages:
maria: Hey team — quick heads up: we're planning a telemetry schema tightening this week to remove legacy nullable fields (route_legacy_tag, env_hint) and add a normalized 'route_tier' enum. Need to coordinate console queries, alerting, and any dual-write windows. Can folks chime on blockers?

alex: What's the expected surface area for console dashboards? My worry is slow queries if we switch index shapes.

maria: Good q. Primary read surfaces: per-route latency, per-tenant quota dashboards, and the per-model cost breakdown. We'll keep the current read model for 2 weeks behind a feature flag and then flip.

raj: Backfill cost estimate? if we need to rewrite the large events table we should budget GPU/CPU for the job. Any rough row count?

sasha: We sampled yesterday — ~420M rows hitting the old envelope shape in the last 90d. Backfill w/ batching will take ~48-72h if we use 48 workers. Also need to consider customer throttles.

jen: On rollout UX: can we expose a console banner when a user's saved dashboard relies on removed fields? I can add a warning and link to migration docs.

maria: Yes please. Banner + a migration assistant. Also want a canary plan: 5% of routes get mapped to new route_tier tag and we validate query parity.

alex: For query perf, suggest we create a short-lived materialized view keyed by (route_id, route_tier) so dashboard queries don't regress during the flip. Then drop it after 2 weeks.

raj: Agree. Also: quota engine uses route_legacy_tag for some soft limits — I'll add a compatibility shim in the routing service to map old tags to route_tier for 30d. That buys us time.

sasha: Backfill snippet I'm proposing (psql):

```sql
BEGIN;
ALTER TABLE analytics.events ADD COLUMN route_tier text;
-- populate in chunks to avoid write spikes
UPDATE analytics.events
SET route_tier = CASE WHEN route_legacy_tag LIKE 'enterprise%' THEN 'premium' ELSE 'standard' END
WHERE id BETWEEN $start AND $end;
COMMIT;
```

sasha: We'll run that with chunk size 250k and observe replication lag.

maria: Nice. Two operational items: 1) ingesters must emit route_tier for new events (patch goes out tonight), 2) telemetry schema registry needs a new version tag so downstream tools pick it up.

ingest-bot: deploy notice: ingest-service v2.14.0 rolled to staging at 2026-03-18T02:15Z by sasha — feature flag route_tier enabled for staging.

alex: When can we get the materialized view created? I'll own that. Need an exact schema mapping from sasha.

sasha: I'll post the mapping in the doc. Rough mapping: enterprise* -> premium, partner_* -> partner, else -> standard. Also we'll add a compact enum in the schema: ['standard','partner','premium','internal'].

maria: QA checklist: parity queries (latency, counts), dashboard snapshots for top-100 routes, alert smoke tests, and logs sampling. Can people pick one?

alex: I'll do dashboard snapshots + perf.

raj: I'll validate quota shim and run synthetic quota tests.

jen: I'll implement the console banner and migration assistant draft.

sasha: I'll run the backfill in canary (1%) tomorrow morning and report metrics to #ingest-runbook.

maria: Perfect. If anything blocks, post to this thread. Thanks all :thumbsup:
